CVE-2024-2397.title: Due to a bug in packet data buffers management, the PPP printer i ...
CVE-2024-2397.description: Due to a bug in packet data buffers management, the PPP printer in tcpdump can enter an infinite loop when reading a crafted DLT_PPP_SERIAL .pcap savefile.  This problem does not affect any tcpdump release, but it affected the git master branch from 2023-06-05 to 2024-03-21.
